evidence: Reverts GUI-created PSBTs from version 2 back to version 0 in src/qt/walletmodel.cpp and src/wallet/walletutil.*.
rationale: Fixes a compatibility regression where defaulting to PSBTv2 in the GUI broke workflows with older external tools. As the PR notes, 'defaulting to it causes issues for existing users', making this a worthwhile point-release bug fix.
